name: TC-447: the brief form quotes a RANGE and adds to the cart; the cart repeats it, holds the payment choice, and offers the invoice only when credit is extended
description: 100 cards: $1.95 + $12 shipping = $207.00, +25% spread = $258.75. The brief form's estimate card and 'You won't be charged now' notice carry the range (EN DASH) and its button only adds to the cart — no payment choice there (RestauNax #1072). The cart shows the same range as its estimated total, says nothing is charged until the final invoice, and holds the payment choice: 'Charge the card on file' checked, 'Add it to my next RestauNax bill' only when the cart says credit is available — a throwaway tenant has no subscription, so the test branches on the API's answer.
